organza-lehengas.intro: Explore floral printed organza lehengas in a choice of colors, alongside a lavender organza skirt with a floral embroidered blouse. Compare the included lehenga, choli or blouse piece, and dupatta on each listing before choosing your finish.
editorial: Organza describes the skirt fabric in this selection, not just a dupatta. Floral printed colorways combine sequins and zari embroidery; the lavender design pairs a plain organza skirt with an embroidered blouse and a soft-net dupatta. Fiber composition is not assumed to be pure silk.

Check the exact size and finish before ordering. Semi-stitched and fabric-only selections require tailoring before wear; a model photograph does not mean every variant is ready to wear. Any listed stitching option has its own price and processing requirements.

faqs.question: Is the lehenga skirt made from organza?
faqs.answer: The selected product descriptions identify the lehenga or skirt fabric as organza. Dupatta and blouse fabrics can differ; check the individual product details.

faqs.question: What is included?
faqs.answer: Each selected listing includes a lehenga, choli or blouse piece, and dupatta. The finish varies: some include semi-stitched garments or unstitched fabric. Jewelry and styling accessories are not included unless explicitly listed.

faqs.question: Are all organza lehengas ready to wear?
faqs.answer: No. Choose from the finishes actually available on the product page. Semi-stitched and fabric-only options need tailoring, and stitching choices require additional processing. Confirm timing before ordering for a fixed event date.

A photographed outfit shows the styled look, not the finish of every purchasable variant. Review the listed size, included pieces and stitching selection before adding a set to your bag. Confirm tailoring and delivery timing with LuxeMia for a fixed event date.

faqs.question: What qualifies a set for this collection?
faqs.answer: The reviewed product details explicitly identify mirror work on a lehenga choli set. Sequin-only styles and products mentioning mirrors only as styling accessories are not included.

faqs.question: What comes with the outfit?
faqs.answer: The selected listings include a lehenga, choli and dupatta. Do not assume jewelry, a bag or other photographed accessories are included unless the exact product description says so.

faqs.question: Are all mirror work lehengas supplied stitched?
faqs.answer: No. Finishes vary by listing and selected option. Review whether your choice is readymade, unstitched or requires custom tailoring, then check the measurements and processing requirements before ordering.
